t: Dryzone Fast-Set damp resistant plaster is a breathable renovation plaster for repairing damp-affected internal walls. Designed for fast turnaround projects, it suits plasterers working on kitchens, basements and other moisture-prone areas. The fast-set formula hardens in around 2 hours, reducing downtime, while its porous structure allows walls to dry and helps control salt movement that can damage finishes. With strong adhesion to brick, block and stone, it delivers reliable performance for dubbing out uneven surfaces and completing damp-proofing systems. Should not be applied over plasterboard or bitumen-based coatings. After at least 14 days, decorative finishes such as emulsion paint or wallpaper may be applied (to maintain breathability and prevent future issues with damp retention, only non-vinyl-based emulsion paints should be used). Each 20kg bag provides coverage of approximately 1m² at a total thickness of 20mm (2-coat system).
